content.title: E2E validation test suite
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/e2e-validation-suite-spec.md

Create an end-to-end test suite in the validation/ folder that exercises the agt CLI against real git repositories. The library-validator uses git init + agt init --branch=<name> to create isolated test environments, then runs real CLI commands and validates output. No mocks, no in-memory simulations — highest confidence testing layer.

content.content:
Issue breakdown complete. Two child tasks created and assigned to library-validator:

1. mpebmstgs9 → mpebmy32vc (spec review, in-progress) — review the E2E spec for testability concerns before implementation starts
2. mpebmstgs9 → mpebnnq5qq (implementation, todo, blocked by mpebmy32vc) — audit existing tests, build E2E infrastructure, write all test files

Delegation rationale: library-validator owns testing and quality gates. The spec is detailed enough for implementation but benefits from a tester's review before coding begins. The blockage ensures the review feeds into the implementation.
